name: Oklo
description: Developer of the Aurora powerhouse, a liquid-metal-cooled, metal-fuelled fast reactor of up to 75 MWe sold under long-term power agreements; the first plant at Idaho National Laboratory is forecast to begin commercial operations in 2028, with a DOE-to-NRC licence conversion in progress.
